parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Service Mesh instance is located
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A required parameter. Set the value to `servicemesh`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A list of mesh instance IDs

fields.help_en:
The tag key.

Constraints:

The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length.

The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Must not contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。

限制：

不能为空。
N的取值范围为1~20。
最多支持128个字符。
不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头。
不能包含`http://`和`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

Constraints:

The tag value cannot be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.

The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
